set.tovw: Lead grade D (treasure thread): cache doubtful
set.st: Robbers of the Grass Lake bank fled to a hotel off Wolf Lake Road; police recovered most of the loot, but about $1,300 in gold and silver was never found. A Jackson paper a week later said the evidence pointed to someone picking the money up at the lakeside cottage during the gunfight, so a roadside cache is doubtful. Pin is the village point, not the spot itself.
set.t: Later report (4 Aug 1920) suggests the coins were pocketed at the cottage, not cached. Wet ground along the 1920 getaway route was never searched. Access: unknown.

src: Jackson News, 4 Aug 1920, p. 5, 'Who Got the $1,300 Missed in Bank Loot?'
